description: Bulk-set the "In escrow scope" checkbox (codebase escrow.enabled) across many codebases in one call — scope a whole fleet into (or out of) the escrow deposit sweep without clicking per-codebase checkboxes. Requires `write` scope. Target by repos ("owner/name") and/or codebaseIds, up to 1000 per call. Repos with no codebase yet (not analyzed) come back in `unmatchedRepos` — run Phase-1 analysis first, then retry those. Optional clientTag tags every matched codebase for one beneficiary; disabling never clears an existing tag.

clientTag.description: Beneficiary tag (≤60 chars) stamped on every matched codebase.

enabled.description: true = include in escrow scope, false = remove.

repos.description: Repo full names ("owner/name") to match against codebases.

name: anyforge_set_escrow_scope
title: Set escrow scope
